---
title: "Key Penang Statistics"
pagetitle: Key Penang Statistics by Penang Institute
title-prefix: ""
description: |
  Dashboards and datasets on Penang's economy and society, maintained by
  Penang Institute's Socioeconomics & Statistics Programme from official
  government sources.
listing:
  - id: metrics
    contents: keyPenangMetrics/output/metrics_grid.yaml
    template: assets/glance.ejs
  - id: penang-monthly
    contents: keyPenangMetrics/output/penang-monthly-stats.yaml
    date-format: "MMMM YYYY"
    type: grid
    page-size: 3
    # Client chose the "image, date and standfirst" card (Oct 2026), so the
    # cards carry an image and the feed's own summary. Every article in an
    # issue shares one pubDate, so the default date sort has nothing to
    # separate them; `order` is the feed's running order, written by
    # metrics.py, and pins the cards to the magazine's own sequence.
    sort: "order"
    fields: [image, date, title, description, author]
  - id: dashboards-econ
    contents:
    - dashboards/econ/*.qmd
    type: grid
    grid-columns: 3
    fields: [title, description]
  - id: dashboards-sector
    contents:
    - dashboards/sector/*.qmd
    type: grid
    grid-columns: 3
    fields: [title, description]
  - id: dashboards-social
    contents:
    - dashboards/social/*.qmd
    type: grid
    grid-columns: 3
    fields: [title, description]
title-block-banner: '#c3353c'
title-block-banner-color: 'white'
---

```{=html}
<div class="revamp-search-wrap" role="search">
  <div class="revamp-search">
    <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m20 20-3.8-3.8"/></svg>
    <input id="revamp-search-input" type="search" autocomplete="off"
           placeholder="Search dashboards and datasets — e.g. inflation, household income"
           aria-label="Search dashboards and datasets">
  </div>
  <ul id="revamp-search-results" hidden></ul>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  var input = document.getElementById('revamp-search-input');
  var list = document.getElementById('revamp-search-results');
  var docs = null;

  function load() {
    if (docs) return Promise.resolve(docs);
    // Dashboard cards carry curated descriptions that the page-text index
    // lacks (dashboard pages are mostly embedded Tableau frames), so fold
    // them in as first-priority documents.
    var cards = Array.prototype.map.call(
      document.querySelectorAll('a.quarto-grid-link'),
      function (a) {
        var title = a.querySelector('.card-title');
        var desc = a.querySelector('.listing-description');
        if (!title) return null;
        return { href: a.getAttribute('href'),
                 title: title.textContent.trim(),
                 section: '',
                 text: desc ? desc.textContent.trim() : '' };
      }).filter(Boolean);
    return fetch('search.json').then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (json) { docs = cards.concat(json); return docs; });
  }

  function snippet(text, q) {
    var i = text.toLowerCase().indexOf(q);
    if (i < 0) return text.slice(0, 90);
    var start = Math.max(0, i - 30);
    return (start ? '…' : '') + text.slice(start, i + q.length + 60) + '…';
  }

  function render(hits, q) {
    list.innerHTML = '';
    if (!hits.length) {
      list.innerHTML = '<li class="rs-empty">No matches for “' + q + '”</li>';
    } else {
      hits.forEach(function (h) {
        var li = document.createElement('li');
        var a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = h.href;
        a.innerHTML = '<strong>' + h.title + '</strong>' +
          (h.section ? ' <span class="rs-section">' + h.section + '</span>' : '') +
          '<span class="rs-snippet">' + snippet(h.text || '', q) + '</span>';
        li.appendChild(a);
        list.appendChild(li);
      });
    }
    list.hidden = false;
  }

  function search(q) {
    q = q.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (q.length < 2) { list.hidden = true; return; }
    load().then(function (docs) {
      var seen = {};
      var hits = docs
        .map(function (d) {
          var t = (d.title || '').toLowerCase();
          var body = (d.text || '').toLowerCase();
          var page = (d.href || '').replace(location.origin, '').replace(/^\.?\//, '').split('#')[0];
          var score = t.indexOf(q) === 0 ? 4 : t.includes(q) ? 3 : body.includes(q) ? 1 : 0;
          if (score && page.indexOf('dashboards/') === 0) score += 1;
          return { d: d, page: page, score: score };
        })
        .filter(function (x) { return x.score > 0; })
        .sort(function (a, b) { return b.score - a.score; })
        .filter(function (x) {
          if (seen[x.page]) return false;
          seen[x.page] = true;
          return true;
        })
        .slice(0, 8)
        .map(function (x) { return x.d; });
      render(hits, q);
    });
  }

  input.addEventListener('input', function () { search(input.value); });
  input.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      var first = list.querySelector('a');
      if (first) window.location.href = first.href;
    }
    if (e.key === 'Escape') { list.hidden = true; input.blur(); }
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    if (!e.target.closest('.revamp-search-wrap')) list.hidden = true;
  });
})();

// Fill the glance-card view counters from Tableau Public counts fetched at
// build time by scripts/fetch_view_counts.py (a step in update-submodules.yml).
//
// .glance-views ships EMPTY from glance.ejs and is filled in here. It used to
// ship as "views counter to add", which meant any run where view_counts.json
// was missing published that scaffolding text to the live homepage. Empty +
// `.glance-views:empty { display: none }` degrades to nothing visible instead.
(function () {
  function label(n) {
    return n.toLocaleString('en-MY') + ' dashboard views';
  }

  function stemOf(href) {
    return (href || '').split('/').pop().replace('.html', '');
  }

  // "Penang at a glance" cards (custom glance.ejs template).
  function fillGlanceCards(counts) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.glance-card').forEach(function (card) {
      var link = card.querySelector('.glance-links a');
      var el = card.querySelector('.glance-views');
      if (!link || !el) return;
      var n = counts[stemOf(link.getAttribute('href'))];
      if (n == null) return;
      el.innerHTML = label(n);
    });
  }

  // Dashboard listing cards (Quarto's stock grid template, so there is no
  // markup hook to fill: the line is created here and appended to .card-body).
  //
  // Scoped to the three dashboard listings by id rather than matching
  // .quarto-grid-item globally. The Penang Monthly listing renders
  // .quarto-grid-item too, and those are articles with no workbook behind
  // them, so a global match would hang a view count on every one of them.
  function fillDashboardCards(counts) {
    var sel = ['econ', 'sector', 'social'].map(function (s) {
      return '#listing-dashboards-' + s + ' .quarto-grid-item';
    }).join(', ');

    document.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach(function (card) {
      if (card.querySelector('.listing-views')) return;      // don't double-insert
      var wrapper = card.closest('a');                        // grid item is anchor-wrapped
      if (!wrapper) return;
      var n = counts[stemOf(wrapper.getAttribute('href'))];
      if (n == null) return;                                  // e.g. archived dashboards
      var body = card.querySelector('.card-body') || card;
      var el = document.createElement('div');
      el.className = 'listing-views';
      el.innerHTML = label(n);
      body.appendChild(el);
    });
  }

  fetch('keyPenangMetrics/output/view_counts.json')
    .then(function (r) {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status);
      return r.json();
    })
    .then(function (counts) {
      fillGlanceCards(counts);
      fillDashboardCards(counts);
    })
    .catch(function () { /* no counts file: both card types simply show none */ });
})();
</script>
```

```{=html}
<script>
  // Append "Data as of <period>" and "Updated <date>" footers to each
  // "Penang at a glance" card.
  //
  // Option A ("Data as of") comes from the card's .card-title (the data
  // period from metrics_grid.yaml).
  //
  // Option B ("Updated") comes from the last_updated field in
  // metrics_grid.json, written by the pipeline each time it runs.
  //
  // Both footers are appended inside .card-body so Bootstrap's flex layout
  // pushes them to the bottom of the card without overflow.
  //
  // The Option A revamp renders these as .glance-card divs (assets/glance.ejs),
  // NOT Bootstrap .card elements, and puts the period in .glance-period rather
  // than .card-title. Both shapes are matched below so the badge keeps working
  // whichever layout is in use; matching only .card silently attached nothing.
  (function addCardFooters() {
    function addDataAsOf(cards) {
      cards.forEach(function (card) {
        if (card.querySelector('.data-as-of')) return;
        var body = card.querySelector('.card-body') || card;
        var titleEl = body.querySelector('.card-title, .glance-period');
        var period = titleEl && titleEl.textContent.trim();
        if (!period) return;
        var el = document.createElement('div');
        el.className = 'data-as-of';
        el.textContent = 'Data as of ' + period;
        body.appendChild(el);
      });
    }

    function addUpdatedAt(cards, date) {
      cards.forEach(function (card) {
        if (card.querySelector('.updated-at')) return;
        var body = card.querySelector('.card-body') || card;
        var el = document.createElement('div');
        el.className = 'updated-at';
        el.textContent = 'Updated ' + date;
        body.appendChild(el);
      });
    }

    // Dashboard listing cards asked for the same two footers (client, Sep 2026).
    //
    // Periods are read back off the glance cards already rendered on this page
    // rather than fetched again: each glance card links to its dashboard and
    // carries the period, which is exactly the mapping needed, and it cannot
    // drift out of step with what the visitor is looking at.
    //
    // Only 5 of the 14 dashboards appear in metrics_grid, so only those 5 get
    // dates. The rest are left blank rather than shown a borrowed one:
    // "Updated" is the metrics pipeline's run date, and asserting it for a
    // dashboard the pipeline does not feed would be a claim we cannot support.
    // Same shape as the stemOf in the view-counts block above: takes an href
    // string, returns the file stem. "dashboards/social/pop.html" -> "pop",
    // which is what makes a glance card and a dashboard card comparable even
    // though the two link at different depths.
    function stemOf(href) {
      return (href || '').split('/').pop().replace(/\.html.*$/, '');
    }

    function dashboardPeriods() {
      var map = {};
      document.querySelectorAll('.metrics .card, .metrics .glance-card').forEach(function (card) {
        var periodEl = card.querySelector('.card-title, .glance-period');
        var link = card.querySelector('a[href*="dashboards/"]');
        if (!periodEl || !link) return;
        var stem = stemOf(link.getAttribute('href'));
        if (stem) map[stem] = periodEl.textContent.trim();
      });
      return map;
    }

    function dashboardCards() {
      var sel = ['econ', 'sector', 'social'].map(function (s) {
        return '#listing-dashboards-' + s + ' .quarto-grid-item';
      }).join(', ');
      return Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(sel));
    }

    function stamp(card, cls, text) {
      if (card.querySelector('.' + cls)) return;
      var body = card.querySelector('.card-body') || card;
      var el = document.createElement('div');
      el.className = cls;
      el.textContent = text;
      body.appendChild(el);
    }

    function run() {
      var cards = document.querySelectorAll('.metrics .card, .metrics .glance-card');
      addDataAsOf(cards);

      // Periods for the five headline dashboards come off the glance cards.
      var periods = dashboardPeriods();
      var dated = dashboardCards().filter(function (card) {
        if (card.querySelector('.data-as-of')) return true;
        var wrapper = card.closest('a');            // grid item is anchor-wrapped
        if (!wrapper) return false;
        var period = periods[stemOf(wrapper.getAttribute('href'))];
        if (!period) return false;
        stamp(card, 'data-as-of', 'Data as of ' + period);
        return true;
      });

      fetch('keyPenangMetrics/output/metrics_grid.json')
        .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
        .then(function (data) {
          var updated = data[0] && data[0].last_updated;
          if (!updated) return;
          addUpdatedAt(cards, updated);
          addUpdatedAt(dated, updated);
        })
        .catch(function () { /* graceful: Option A still shows */ });

      // Dashboards outside the headline five carry their own dates, each read
      // from the sheet the pipeline writes (see assets/dashboard_dates.json).
      // A dashboard is listed there only when its transform actually produced
      // rows; the ones whose transform silently writes nothing are left blank
      // on purpose, because a date would assert freshness we cannot support.
      fetch('assets/dashboard_dates.json')
        .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
        .then(function (cfg) {
          var byStem = (cfg && cfg.dashboards) || {};
          dashboardCards().forEach(function (card) {
            var wrapper = card.closest('a');
            if (!wrapper) return;
            var entry = byStem[stemOf(wrapper.getAttribute('href'))];
            if (!entry) return;
            if (entry.dataAsOf) stamp(card, 'data-as-of', 'Data as of ' + entry.dataAsOf);
            if (entry.updated)  stamp(card, 'updated-at', 'Updated ' + entry.updated);
          });
        })
        .catch(function () { /* graceful: the other cards still show */ });
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', run);
    } else {
      run();
    }
  })();
</script>
```
